title: LANL and Cornell Researchers Demonstrate Extraction of Quantum Information Structures from Condensed-Matter Dynamical Simulations - Quantum Computing Report
gist: LANL and Cornell show that intermediate states from dynamical quantum simulations (local-pulse protocols used for spin Green functions and neutron-scattering structure factors) can be reused to measure quantum-information quantities like Holevo information, QFI, channel capacity and multipartite entanglement in 50-spin XX and XXX chains. Key finding: compact theoretical descriptions do not imply easy physical readout; scaling requires moving from full tomography to randomized measurements/classical shadows.
